questions.question: What payload range is typical for a full, well-shaped bucket?
questions.explanation: A good bucket fill sits close to, but not above, the rated capacity.

questions.question: Why can the same bucket fill be an overload in one material and not in another?
options: The sensor only works in dry material
It cannot, payload is the same for all materials
questions.explanation: Wet clay and rock weigh much more per cubic metre than topsoil.

questions.question: How should a heavy load be carried while swinging?
options: High and far from the machine
Low and close to the machine, with a slow swing
As fast as possible to reduce cycle time
questions.explanation: Keeping the load low and close keeps the centre of gravity inside the stable area.

questions.question: Repeated overload warnings during a shift usually mean what?
options: Technique should change, for example smaller bites in dense material
questions.explanation: Repeated warnings point to a loading habit. Adjust the fill to the material.
